_about: Screen geometry. Both windows are borderless and fill their monitor's work area - the monitor minus its taskbar (main: the primary, panel: the other one). `interface` and `panelDesign` are the CSS px sizes each layout was designed at; each scales uniformly by min(window.w / design.w, window.h / design.h) and any leftover of a different aspect goes to the layout, so it fills the screen without stretching.

kamae._about: Kamae at her (hud/src/tracking/kamaeFeatures.ts, trained by core/scripts/kamae_train.py). The pose model scouts on every scoutEveryNthFrame-th camera frame and runs on every poseEveryNthFrame-th for a few seconds once something kamae-like shows; the watcher fires only on a steady 1.5 s hold of both hands out in front, with hysteresis on the way out. enabled is set by kamae_train.py: ON only once the desk confusers (keiko_confusers, ctrl+alt+shift+7) were held out and never fired - off, the pose model is never loaded outside keiko captures.

panel._about: Her panel's centre cycles system -> weather -> news -> markets -> research (her own content first when there is any). Each card holds the centre for its dwellMs - the visual ones longest; touch (mouse, hand, voice) or her content holds it.
